rows.text: §¶｟I, Nephi｠, having been born of goodly parents, therefore I was taught somewhat in all the learning of my father; and having seen many afflictions in the course of my days—nevertheless, having been highly favored of the Lord in all my days; yea, having had a great knowledge of the goodness and the mysteries of God, therefore I make a record of my proceedings in my days;
yea, I make a record in the language of my father, which consists of the learning of the Jews and the language of the Egyptians.
